note: Business jargon pack (English corporate buzzwords), 2026-10-05, beta

Give AI your notes one at a time, becaus.it: Give AI your notes one at a time, because the **overhead** of checking is bigger than making
Give AI your notes one at a time, becaus.mean: extra effort needed to manage something

A note for myself. How to make a draft 🐧.it: A note for myself. My draft **workflow** 🐧
A note for myself. How to make a draft 🐧.mean: the steps used to get a piece of work done

When I take notes of things I want to po.it: Taking notes is fun, but giving AI a big pile at once means I must **double-check** all sentences later, get bored, and get tired.
When I take notes of things I want to po.mean: to check something a second time to be sure

But today I realized..it: But today I had an **aha moment**.

Copying and pasting to AI one by one is.it: A **bite-sized** approach, pasting one by one, is better than pasting them all together.

Because if I don't split it small and ch.it: If I don't split it small and check the output, my **bandwidth** for judgment does not last.
Because if I don't split it small and ch.mean: the energy and time a person has for tasks

Maybe the surprisingly annoying thing in.it: The surprising **pain point** of the AI era may be that a human must check all of the AI's large output.
Maybe the surprisingly annoying thing in.mean: a specific problem that keeps annoying people

Maybe checking is harder than making.it: Maybe the **review** is harder than making
Maybe checking is harder than making.mean: looking carefully at work to find problems
